review_scope: Proposed policy and frozen A/M annotations only; no compiled output or target-domain audit.
accepted_policy_points: Exact electronic37record scope plus the single postlude as a separately fixed38th component resolves source-unit accounting conditionally on that declared target-unit law; it does not certify31original historical recipes.
Lemma identity with occurrence role separate resolves folium role-category splitting without asserting botanical identity.
Noun amulum versus verb amulo; addo versus adicio; fiat=fio; aspargo versus adspargo are coherent explicit global policies.
One global OPEN/CLOSE type per explicit span kind, with each lexical occurrence emitted only once, avoids phrase-specific macro atoms and quantity double emission.
Unbound literal references can be encoded without invented antecedents or executed quantities.
Identical span endpoints with different kinds can both be represented, provided a deterministic global tie convention is frozen.
